notes:
Quick CRM notes:
- Lead: VP Eng (Maya Chen) very focused on query cost/unit and 99th-pct latency at scale.
- Use-case: customer-support KB RAG + in-thread reranking for suggested replies. High QPS during business hours (peaks ~200-300 qps).
- Index size: currently ~3.8M docs (processed to ~4.2M after enrichment), ~4M vectors expected; adding weekly delta ~120k docs.
- Wants hosted API (no on-prem right now) but strict residency controls for EU clients.
- Security: must pass SAML SSO + KMS integration; audit logs retention 1 year.
- Quote from Maya: "We need <120ms median, <350ms p99 for rerank + generation flow or we lose product SLAs."
- Pricing sensitivity: will evaluate total cost per query including embedding + ANN search + reranker. Looking for batching/caching recommendations.
- Model preference: open / quantized models where possible (saves cost) but ok with Redwood-managed models for fallback. Interested in Optimize recommendations (quantization, kernel selection).
- Current architecture: embeddings indexed in external vector store (self-hosted), application-layer rerank cross-encoder runs in Kubernetes (CPU-heavy). They want to consolidate to reduce end-to-end cost and variance.
- Redwood POC: deployed hosted API for embeddings + candidate retrieval -> local cross-encoder rerank test vs Redwood reranker. Early results: retrieval latencies good, but rerank end-to-end p99 spikes during peak.
- Action items: SE to provide batching/caching config + estimated cost model for 200 qps sustained; Security to provide SAML/KMS checklist; AE to send revised pricing with optional dedicated pool for business-hours bursts.

workload_summary: SaaS KB RAG for support workflows. Moderate indexing scale (3.8-4.2M docs), high QPS peaks (200-300). Need embeddings for semantic retrieval + lightweight cross-encoder reranking for top-10 candidates. Latency-sensitive for user-facing suggestions and reply generation.
performance_targets: Median latency target <120ms for retrieval + rerank; p99 end-to-end target <350ms at 200 QPS sustained. Throughput target: 250 qps with graceful degradation. Token-generation latency targets non-critical (can be async for longer prompts).
indexing_requirements: Weekly delta ingestion ~120k documents; need fast incremental indexing and re-embedding pipeline. Retention policy: keep full text + derived metadata for 2 years. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for sharding, quantization, and prefix caching to reduce ANN cost.
cost_constraints: Must present cost-per-query model (embedding + ANN + reranker). Target effective cost <= $0.02/query at 200 qps average monthly; willing to pay premiums for stability (burst capacity) but want clear unit economics.
